name: Atlas Boot Diagnostics Fixture
description: Test fixture for the Atlas boot diagnostics E2E tests: ships one asset of each broken shape a mod author can ship by mistake (malformed JSON, an unknown/wrong-typed property, a recipe referencing a missing item), plus a ModSystem that logs through the shared api.Logger with its own hand-written bracket and through its own Mod.Logger, so the engine's own reporting of every shape (asset diagnostics and both logger routes) is exercised end to end.
